scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:server

comments.dependencies: Everything the browser needs is compiled into the committed docs/ bundle, so nothing here is required at runtime by the app. `dependencies` is reserved for what the multiplayer server process itself needs (ws, from phase 1), which keeps `npm ci --omit=dev` on the VPS down to almost nothing.
comments.engines: What the *deployed artifact* needs. dist-server/main.mjs targets node18 and the VPS runs 18.19, so requiring 22 here only produced an EBADENGINE warning on every production install. Building and testing needs node 22 (see .nvmrc) — vite and playwright declare that themselves, so a developer on 18 still gets told.
